title: pm-dispatch / os-dev: the claim template and the dev definition carry only the `Clause-②:` line, so a dispatched PR never writes the `Metadata-protocol:` line ruling A (#25105) adds
body:
Filing gate **③** (a maintainer-direct ruling's unlanded half). Carries the `.claude/**` half of #25105's item 1 ("Every PR and changeset states its metadata-protocol kind"); #25105 keeps items 1–5 on `scripts/**`, `AGENTS.md` and `pr-automation.yml` (PR #25114, Tier H, awaiting approval). Filed by `domain:spec` seat 1 (seat post #6017, session `session_01VsqhiSrBjB1wJfRNcHPeXN`) from the dev's out-of-scope finding on #25105 (report `6315700975`). ⛔ Not a claim. Lane and grade are triage's; the parent is p1.

Blocked-by: #25105

**Reader (who acts):** the `domain:skills` seat, once triage routes it and #25105 lands (the spelling is final only when PR #25114 merges).

## Why

PR #25114 adds a sibling declaration line beside `Clause-②:` in every PR body and changeset body: `Metadata-protocol: added | narrowed | semantic | none`. `scripts/check-changeset-no-major.mjs` then grades the changeset level on it, and an unread kind that decides the verdict is `not-measured-material` (red). The fleet's own dispatch path does not know the line:

- `.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/SKILL.md:314`, the claim template: `Clause-②: yes | no` only.
- `.claude/agents/os-dev.md:280`: "认领带 `Clause-②:` 行才照抄进正文行首 … 无则零写,⛔ 不自造" — so a dev copies only `Clause-②:` and is told not to invent a line.
- `.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/execution-duties.md:70`: the claim's `Clause-②` spelling rule.

Read at `origin/main` `5050442bb9` by the filing seat (each line printed with `git show origin/main:PATH | sed -n Np`). The dev also names `os-dev.md:277` (the dogfood trigger reads the `(narrowing)` arm), `references/contract-review.md:8–19` and `references/landing-operations.md:11` (review routing on `Clause-②`); whether those need the kind is the implementing dev's measurement, not this card's claim.

**Consequence once PR #25114 lands, until this card lands:** every dispatched PR that carries a changeset reads `not-measured-material` once and clears it by one PR-body line (no push), and its changeset carries no kind for the release-notes grouping or the ADR-0087 gate's `narrowed` signal.

## Wanted

- The claim template and the os-dev definition carry the `Metadata-protocol:` line beside `Clause-②:`: the seat declares the kind at claim, and the dev copies it into the PR body and writes it into each changeset body.
- The seat's claim-time judgment of the kind uses ruling A's table as #25105's body files it (verbatim there; ⛔ not restated here).
- `SKILL.md` is under the line ratchet (`pnpm check:pm-skill-ratchet`): a line added is paid for by a line deleted.

## Dedupe

MCP `search_issues`, objectstack, open and closed: "Metadata-protocol claim template os-dev Clause-② line" → 3 hits (#24298, #23406, #21048, all closed, unrelated). Control query "changeset levels minor only when the metadata protocol changes" → #25105 first. **New.**
